+"""Share broad wash differences, then draw saved stories and cut 85 exact tiles."""
+import json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from common import ROOT
+from round3_symbols import wrecks
+
+def blur(a,s=8):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+def scores(images):
+    return [float(np.abs(blur(cv2.resize(images[z+1],(len(images[z]),)*2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)-images[z])).mean()) for z in range(3)]
+
+def main():
+    images=[np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png'),np.float32) for z in range(4)]
+    log=dict(method='Symmetric continuous-canvas RGB broad-wash relaxation; sigma 8 parent pixels; no resampling of native ink.',initial=scores(images),passes=[])
+    print('initial',log['initial'],flush=True)
+    for step in range(10):
+        for z in ([2,1,0] if step%2==0 else [0,1,2]):
+            parent=images[z];child=images[z+1];n=len(parent)
+            small=cv2.resize(child,(n,n),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            field=np.clip(blur(small-parent),-10,10)
+            parent+=field*.46
+            for k in range(3):child[...,k]-=cv2.resize(field[...,k],(n*2,n*2),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)*.54
+            np.clip(parent,0,255,out=parent);np.clip(child,0,255,out=child)
+        err=scores(images);log['passes'].append(err);print('pass',step+1,err,flush=True)
+        if max(err)<1.65:break
+    for z,a in enumerate(images):
+        im=wrecks(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(a),0,255))),z)
+        im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):im.crop((x*1024,y*1024,(x+1)*1024,(y+1)*1024)).save(ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}/{x}_{y}.png')
+        im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(ROOT/f'reports/round3/z{z}-final.png')
+        print('export',z,flush=True)
+    log['final_float']=scores(images)
+    (ROOT/'reports/round3/balance.json').write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Audit exported RGB, every join, retained world data, and native brush detail.
+
+The visual review remains separate. No drawing-support identity is presented
+as an independent visible-geometry measurement.
+"""
+import hashlib, json
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from scipy.stats import spearmanr
+from common import ROOT
+from audit import png_info
+from round3_bathy import depth_at
+
+R=ROOT/'reports/round3'
+def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def blur(a,s):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+
+def main():
+    report={'time_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'zooms':{},'joins':[],
+        'interpretation':'Visible RGB diagnostics and complete delivery audit. Pigment is not a semantic map; artistic quality is assessed in REPORT.md.'}
+    hashes={}
+    for z in range(4):
+        n=1024*2**z;master=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png'
+        a=np.array(Image.open(master));stitch=np.empty_like(a)
+        expected={f'{x}_{y}.png' for x in range(2**z) for y in range(2**z)}
+        assert expected=={p.name for p in (ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}').glob('*.png')}
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):
+                p=ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}/{x}_{y}.png';im=Image.open(p)
+                assert im.mode=='RGB' and im.size==(1024,1024)
+                stitch[y*1024:(y+1)*1024,x*1024:(x+1)*1024]=im
+                hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+                for ext in ['raw.png','prompt.txt']:assert (ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.{ext}').exists()
+        item=dict(tiles=4**z,pixels=n,reconstruction_max=int(np.abs(a.astype(np.int16)-stitch).max()))
+        assert item['reconstruction_max']==0
+        for axis in ['vertical','horizontal']:
+            v=a if axis=='vertical' else a.transpose(1,0,2)
+            for k in range(1,2**z):
+                c=k*1024
+                for j in range(2**z):
+                    s=v[j*1024:(j+1)*1024,c-33:c+34].astype(np.int16)
+                    jumps=np.abs(np.diff(s,axis=1)).mean((0,2))
+                    cross=float(jumps[32]);adjacent=float((jumps[31]+jumps[33])/2)
+                    near=float(np.delete(jumps,32).mean())
+                    report['joins'].append(dict(z=z,axis=axis,coordinate=c,segment=j,jump=cross,immediate_neighbours=adjacent,
+                        ratio_immediate=cross/max(adjacent,.0001),nearby_66_boundaries=near,ratio_nearby=cross/max(near,.0001)))
+        if z:
+            p=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z-1}/final-master.png'),np.float32)
+            small=np.array(Image.fromarray(a).resize((n//2,n//2),Image.Resampling.BOX),np.float32)
+            delta=small-p
+            item['parent_rgb_mae_255']={'raw':float(np.abs(delta).mean()),'blur4':float(np.abs(blur(delta,4)).mean()),'blur8':float(np.abs(blur(delta,8)).mean()),
+                                      'blur16':float(np.abs(blur(delta,16)).mean()),'mean_shift':delta.mean((0,1)).tolist()}
+        w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+        af=a.astype(np.float32)
+        observed=(af[...,1]-af[...,0]>3)&(af[...,2]-af[...,0]>-18)
+        item['water_pigment']={'fixed_round2_classifier_iou':float((observed&w).sum()/(observed|w).sum()),
+            'source_water_fraction_classified':float(observed[w].mean()),'source_land_fraction_classified_as_teal':float(observed[~w].mean())}
+        edge=w&~nd.binary_erosion(w,border_value=1);edge[[0,-1]]=False;edge[:,[0,-1]]=False
+        oe=observed&~nd.binary_erosion(observed,border_value=1)
+        dist=nd.distance_transform_edt(~oe)[edge]
+        item['shore_pigment_proximity']={'mean_px':float(dist.mean()),'p95_px':float(np.percentile(dist,95)),
+            'max_px':float(dist.max()),'within_2_px':float((dist<=2).mean()),'limit':'One-way proximity to teal pigment, not a proof of survey accuracy.'}
+        # Retained z3 water and building drawing: inspect local contrast, rather
+        # than treating changed broad depth colour as lost native illustration.
+        if z>=2:
+            old=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png'),np.float32)
+            gray=af.mean(2);og=old.mean(2)
+            hp=gray-blur(gray,2);ohp=og-blur(og,2)
+            b=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/buildings.png'))>0
+            safe=nd.binary_erosion(w,iterations=8)
+            item['retained_native_drawing']={}
+            for label,mask in [('buildings',b),('water',safe)]:
+                x=hp[mask][::8];y=ohp[mask][::8]
+                item['retained_native_drawing'][label]=dict(highpass_correlation=float(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]),
+                    highpass_std_ratio=float(x.std()/max(y.std(),.001)))
+            del old,hp,ohp
+        # An overview statistic for depth relationships; this is not navigation.
+        overview=np.array(Image.fromarray(a).resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.BOX),np.float32)
+        ow=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'references/z0/surface_water.png'))>0
+        safe=nd.binary_erosion(ow,iterations=6)
+        lum=blur(overview.mean(2),8);dep=depth_at(1024)
+        item['depth_vs_darkness_rank_correlation']=float(spearmanr(dep[safe][::8],-lum[safe][::8]).statistic)
+        report['zooms'][str(z)]=item
+        print(z,'parent',item.get('parent_rgb_mae_255'),'water',item['water_pigment'],flush=True)
+    assert len(report['joins'])==140
+    report['join_count']=len(report['joins'])
+    report['join_max_immediate']=max(x['ratio_immediate'] for x in report['joins'])
+    report['join_max_nearby']=max(x['ratio_nearby'] for x in report['joins'])
+    prior=json.loads((R/'prior-sha256.json').read_text())
+    preserved={}
+    for key,h in prior.items():
+        if key.startswith('base/') and key!='base/VALUES.md':
+            preserved[key]=sha(ROOT/key)==h;assert preserved[key],key
+    report['existing_base_unchanged']=preserved
+    for z in range(4):
+        originals=list((ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}').glob('*.raw.png'))
+        assert len(originals)==4**z
+        for p in originals:hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    report['originals_changed']=[k for k,h in hashes.items() if k.endswith('.raw.png') and prior.get(k)!=h]
+    report['z3_originals_unchanged']=all(hashes[k]==h for k,h in prior.items() if k.startswith('paintings/z3/') and k.endswith('.raw.png'))
+    assert report['z3_originals_unchanged']
+    for p in (ROOT/'base').glob('*.png'):
+        info=png_info(p);n=8192 if p.stem.endswith('_fine') else 4065
+        assert info['width']==info['height']==n and info['color_type']==0
+        assert info['bit_depth']==(16 if p.name=='height.png' else 8)
+    report['engine_corners']={name:[4064-e,4064+n] for name,e,n in [('NW',-4064,4064),('NE',4064,4064),('SE',4064,-4064),('SW',-4064,-4064)]}
+    for folder in ['base','style']:
+        for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob('*'):
+            if p.is_file():hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    for p in (ROOT/'paintings').rglob('*'):
+        if p.is_file() and (p.name.endswith('.prompt.txt') or p.name in ['retained-paint.png','water-parent.png']):hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    (R/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
+    (R/'sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,indent=2))
+    print('PASS: 85 tiles, 85 originals, 140 joins, zero cut error, original world layers unchanged.',flush=True)
+    print('worst immediate / neighborhood',report['join_max_immediate'],report['join_max_nearby'],flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Four different drawn wreck stories, at the four frozen world hulls.
+
+Far symbols exaggerate size (as round two did), never position or direction.
+Close symbols use the source length/beam. All internal salvage detail is fiction.
+"""
+import math
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from common import vectors, SIZE
+
+def wrecks(im,z):
+    mpp=SIZE/im.width;s=4
+    for g,p in vectors('future_changes'):
+        if p['kind']!='submerged_wreck':continue
+        length=max(p['length_m']/mpp,17 if z==0 else 22 if z==1 else 0)
+        width=max(p['width_m']/mpp,5.5 if z==0 else 7 if z==1 else 0)
+        side=math.ceil(length+width+12);sheet=Image.new('RGBA',(side*s,side*s));d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
+        angle=-math.radians(p['angle_degrees'])
+        def q(u,v):
+            x=u*length;y=v*width
+            return ((side/2+x*math.cos(angle)-y*math.sin(angle))*s,(side/2+x*math.sin(angle)+y*math.cos(angle))*s)
+        ink=(67,91,80,210);pale=(199,195,151,230);rust=(142,108,69,210);wash=(91,126,113,170)
+        k=p['id']
+        hull=[(-.49,0),(-.36,-.43),(.28,-.46),(.5,0),(.28,.44),(-.36,.43)]
+        if k==1:hull=[(-.48,-.38),(.35,-.38),(.48,-.18),(.48,.32),(-.48,.38)]
+        d.polygon([q(*a) for a in hull],fill=wash)
+        d.line([q(*a) for a in hull[:4]],fill=ink,width=2)
+        d.line([q(*a) for a in hull[4:]+[hull[0]]],fill=ink,width=2)
+        if k==0:
+            # Broken cargo spine; the two halves no longer share a straight keel.
+            for i,u in enumerate([-.30,-.18,-.05,.13,.26]):
+                d.line([q(u,-.32),q(u+.025,.29 if i!=2 else -.02)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.35,0),q(-.09,0)],fill=rust,width=3)
+            d.line([q(.06,.09),q(.32,.09)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        elif k==1:
+            # Low barge, two empty square holds and one folded wall.
+            for u in [-.22,.12]:
+                d.line([q(u-.1,-.23),q(u+.1,-.23),q(u+.1,.20),q(u-.1,.20),q(u-.1,-.23)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.38,.34),q(-.16,.08)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        elif k==2:
+            # Little working hull, offset broken cabin and bare stern.
+            d.line([q(-.15,-.25),q(.10,-.25),q(.1,.21),q(-.15,.21),q(-.15,-.25)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(.12,0),q(.35,-.22)],fill=rust,width=3)
+            d.line([q(-.35,-.25),q(-.35,.25)],fill=pale,width=2)
+        else:
+            # Narrow rib cage with a missing side and a fallen mast.
+            for u in [-.25,-.06,.13,.29]:d.line([q(u,-.33),q(u,.32)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.1,-.38),q(.32,.14)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        sheet=sheet.resize((side,side),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+        cx=(p['center'][0]+4064)/mpp;cy=(4064-p['center'][1])/mpp
+        im.paste(sheet,(round(cx-side/2),round(cy-side/2)),sheet)
+    return im

 Offline source/art tools only. They add no dependency to the engine or its build.
 
-## Current delivery: round two
+## Current delivery: round three
+
+Round three keeps the accepted room paintings and most distant land, repaints
+water at its own scales, and adds distinct far landmark pictures. A retained
+round-two finish at each scale is a deliberate production input, verified
+against all 85 pre-change tiles. This avoids re-rendering accepted land through
+a changed pipeline. New z0/z1 originals supply selected land and water; 15 new
+z2 originals supply water; z2 `0_0` and all 64 z3 originals remain unchanged.
+
+Reproduce the delivered artwork offline from kept files, with no image calls,
+network request, or git access:
+
+```sh
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/reference.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 0
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 1
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 2
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 3
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_export.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_measure.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_review.py
+```
+
+| Tool | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| round3_bathy.py | Download the exact NOAA coastal DEM subset if needed; read true coordinate arrays instead of stale regional bounding attributes; freeze a lossless georeferenced Float32 subset; render the initial depth guide. Not needed for offline finishing when the retained GeoTIFF exists. |
+| round3_contexts.py | Prepare the 15 new native z2 painting contexts and their prompts. Generation only; uses the frozen z1 generation-time parent. |
+| round3.py Z | Assemble/align the new originals, preserve accepted land outside local story selections, constrain broad water pigment to observed depth, keep native brush marks, and replace the far mainland mechanical coast trace. Writes continuous unbalanced masters. |
+| round3_symbols.py | Four individual wreck interiors, keeping saved centres and bearings; size exaggeration only at z0/z1. |
+| round3_export.py | Symmetric broad wash calibration, wrecks, and exact 1,024² tile cuts. No tile-edge retouch. |
+| round3_measure.py | Every join, exact reconstruction, broad RGB differences at three blur radii, fixed water-pigment classification, base integrity, original inventory and retained native-detail correlations. |
+| round3_review.py | Round-two/three comparison, all zooms, all tile contact sheets, landmark/coast details, worst joins and a marker-overlay study. All review evidence is under reports/round3/. |
+
+`paintings/z*/retained-paint.png` is kept artwork, not an ignored intermediate.
+`paintings/z1/water-parent.png` and `reports/round3/z0-registered-study.png` record
+generation-time parents. New exact prompts are beside the replaced originals.
+The existing registration-image caches remain ignored; the finishing result
+must be identical with or without them. `base/bathymetry/README.md` explains the
+depth datum and the distinction between observed underwater forms and artistic
+wash. No data or engine coordinate convention from round two is replaced.
+
+Do not use the round-one/two export entry points for the current delivery.
+
+## Historical delivery: round two
 
 The original geographic pipeline below remains authoritative for source layers. The current art finish is **round2.py**, followed by **round2_balance.py**. Do not use the old `finish.py` entry point to export the round-two delivery: its all-features-at-all-scales treatment is the artistic behavior replaced in this round. Its registration/overlap helpers are still used for the close original paintings.

+"""Round three: localized land pictures, painted data-led water, continuous cuts.
+
+Retained-paint.png is the frozen accepted round-two finish, a production input.
+New generated originals supply the native hand. Bathymetry controls the broad
+underwater structure; the existing source coast remains authoritative.
+"""
+import argparse, json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from common import ROOT, SIZE, vectors
+from round2 import far_register, assemble_far, wet, major_roads, INK
+from round3_bathy import pigment
+from finish import load
+
+R=ROOT/'reports/round3'
+# Soft editorial selection, in overview pixels. Pictorial symbols, not world
+# footprint additions. Far diagrams only; z2/z3 retain all source-bound rooms.
+PLACES=[('banyan_arcade',125,241,100,86),('drowned_towers',172,447,90,115),
+        ('reed_bowl',208,554,62,56),('deco_gallery',915,479,72,70),
+        ('tank_grove',714,925,87,72),('belle_loggia',737,355,37,34)]
+
+def far_land_mask(n):
+    y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n].astype(np.float32);x*=1024/n;y*=1024/n
+    mask=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+    for _,cx,cy,rx,ry in PLACES:
+        r=np.sqrt(((x-cx)/rx)**2+((y-cy)/ry)**2)
+        mask=np.maximum(mask,np.clip((1-r)/.18,0,1))
+    return mask
+
+def register(z):
+    n=1024*2**z;w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    cache=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/round3.registered.png'
+    if cache.exists():return load(cache)
+    if z==0:
+        a,info=far_register(load(ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.raw.png',(n,n)),w)
+        (R/'z0-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+        (ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+    elif z==1:a=assemble_far(z,w)
+    else:
+        from alignment import shore_align
+        g=64;s=1152;a=np.zeros((n,n,3),np.float32);total=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+        ramp=np.ones(s,np.float32);ramp[:128]=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,128))**2;ramp[-128:]=ramp[:128][::-1]
+        weight=ramp[:,None]*ramp[None,:];padded=np.pad(w,g,mode='edge');logs={}
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):
+                source=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.raw.png',(s,s))
+                source_water=(source[...,1]-source[...,0]>1)&(source[...,2]-source[...,0]>-48)
+                tile,info=shore_align(source,padded[y*1024:y*1024+s,x*1024:x*1024+s],source_water)
+                logs[f'{x}_{y}']=info
+                (ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+                xa=max(0,x*1024-g);xb=min(n,(x+1)*1024+g);ya=max(0,y*1024-g);yb=min(n,(y+1)*1024+g)
+                u=xa-(x*1024-g);v=ya-(y*1024-g);q=weight[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]
+                a[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=tile[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]*q[...,None];total[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=q
+                print('registered water',x,y,flush=True)
+        a/=np.maximum(total[...,None],.0001)
+        (R/'z2-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs,indent=2))
+    Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(a,0,255))).save(cache)
+    # Read the same frozen precision used on cache hits; cache existence must
+    # never change the exported artwork by a rounding unit.
+    return load(cache)
+
+def extend_water(raw,w):
+    """Nearest safe pigment only for misregistered coast / erroneous margin.
+
+    This does not soften an entire coast or invent a luminous shore-distance
+    field. The source strokes survive throughout correctly painted water.
+    """
+    # Pale green shoals are still water. The older open-teal classifier would
+    # wrongly erase them and form conspicuous nearest-neighbour polygons.
+    source=(raw[...,1]-raw[...,0]>1)&(raw[...,2]-raw[...,0]>-48)
+    bad=w&~source
+    a=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(raw,0,255)),bad.astype(np.uint8),5,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(np.float32)
+    return a
+
+def paint_water(raw,w,z):
+    n=len(w);guide=pigment(n)
+    # Slightly soften the ten-metre DEM's interpolation facets, not the shore.
+    guide=nd.gaussian_filter(guide,(.8*2**z,.8*2**z,0))
+    a=raw if z==3 else extend_water(raw,w)
+    # Normalized filtering avoids dark shore ink or ivory land making halos.
+    sigma=12 if z<2 else 22
+    den=nd.gaussian_filter(w.astype(np.float32),sigma)
+    out=guide.copy()
+    for k in range(3):
+        broad=nd.gaussian_filter(a[...,k]*w,sigma)/np.maximum(den,.0001)
+        detail=a[...,k]-broad
+        if z<3:detail=np.clip(detail,-24,24)
+        if z<=2:
+            # Keep the fresh quill/wash marks. Data, not generated contour drift,
+            # carries all low-frequency depth structure.
+            bias=np.clip(broad-guide[...,k],-10,10)*.3
+            out[...,k]+=detail*.80+bias
+        else:
+            # Existing fine watercolor is accepted: change its large wash only.
+            out[...,k]+=detail
+    return out
+
+def living_coast(out,w,z):
+    """Trace real vectors with a subpixel pen; no staircase or regular dashes."""
+    if z>1:return out
+    n=len(w);s=3
+    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(n*s,n*s));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    from shapely.ops import unary_union
+    # TIGER splits one continuous bay into records. Their internal boundaries
+    # are NOT coast and must never become ink strokes across the sea.
+    for g in [unary_union([g for g,p in vectors('areawater')])]:
+        polys=list(g.geoms) if g.geom_type=='MultiPolygon' else [g]
+        for poly in polys:
+            for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]:
+                pts=np.array(ring.coords,np.float64)
+                px=np.stack([(pts[:,0]+4064)/SIZE*n,(4064-pts[:,1])/SIZE*n],-1)
+                phase=0.
+                for q0,q1 in zip(px[:-1],px[1:]):
+                    delta=q1-q0;length=np.linalg.norm(delta)
+                    if length<.1:continue
+                    normal=np.array([-delta[1],delta[0]])/length
+                    for t in np.arange(0,length,1.5):
+                        tt=min(t+1.6,length);pos=phase+t
+                        # Continuous bounded irregular pen pressure, not dots.
+                        strength=.47+.18*np.sin(pos*.13)+.12*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                        width=.55+.20*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        j0=.45*np.sin(pos*.61)+.18*np.sin(pos*1.31)
+                        j1=.45*np.sin((phase+tt)*.61)+.18*np.sin((phase+tt)*1.31)
+                        a=q0+delta*t/length+normal*j0;b=q0+delta*tt/length+normal*j1
+                        # Beaches retain the original delicate treatment.
+                        u,v=a/n
+                        if u<.29 and v<.66:
+                            strength=.82+.16*np.sin(pos*.13)+.10*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                            width=1.03+.35*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        if u>.91 or v>.82 and u>.49:strength*=.32
+                        if min(a)<1 or max(a)>n-2:continue
+                        d.line([tuple(a*s),tuple(b*s)],fill=(76,78,53,int(210*strength)),width=max(1,round(width*s)))
+                    phase+=length
+    layer=layer.resize((n,n),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+    return np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255))).convert('RGBA'),layer).convert('RGB'),np.float32)
+
+def finish(z):
+    n=1024*2**z
+    print('load accepted paint',z,flush=True)
+    old=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png')
+    w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    rd=major_roads(z,n)
+    print('native masks ready',z,flush=True)
+    raw=register(z) if z<3 else old
+    out=old.copy()
+    if z<2:
+        mask=far_land_mask(n)*(~w)
+        # Keep every principal road at its native source alignment.
+        mask[rd]=0
+        land=raw.copy()
+        wrong=(~w)&wet(raw)&(nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)<14)
+        land[wrong]=old[wrong]
+        out=out*(1-mask[...,None])+land*mask[...,None]
+    print('paint water',z,flush=True)
+    wp=paint_water(raw,w,z);out[w]=wp[w]
+    print('water ready',z,flush=True)
+    # Accepted crane arms project beyond the port's physical land silhouette.
+    # Retain those warm ink marks, not a new strip of land beneath the cranes.
+    if z<2:
+        yy,xx=np.mgrid[:n,:n]
+        port=(xx/n>.30)&(xx/n<.77)&(yy/n>.45)&(yy/n<.66)
+        crane=port&w&(old[...,0]-old[...,1]>2)&(old[...,1]-old[...,2]>12)&(old.mean(2)<205)
+        out[crane]=old[crane]
+    if z<2:
+        # Remove the old mechanical double shore trace on the mainland only.
+        dw=nd.distance_transform_edt(w);dl=nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)
+        y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n];mainland=(x/n<.29)&(y/n<.66)
+        band=mainland&~w&(dl<3.8)&~rd
+        if band.any():
+            mask=band.astype(np.uint8)
+            repaired=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)),mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
+            out[band]=repaired[band]
+    out=living_coast(out,w,z)
+    im=Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)))
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png')
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+    im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(R/f'z{z}-study.png')
+    print('round3 finish',z,flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('zoom',type=int);a=p.parse_args();finish(a.zoom)

+"""Acquire and freeze NOAA bathymetry; render a depth guide, never a new coast.
+
+The NCSS response retains the full dataset's stale actual_range attributes.
+Read lon/lat coordinate arrays explicitly. NOAA identifies the horizontal datum
+as WGS84; the inconsistent spherical grid_mapping attribute is not used.
+"""

+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import requests
+import numpy as np
+import rasterio
+from rasterio.warp import reproject, Resampling
+from affine import Affine
+from scipy.io import netcdf_file
+from PIL import Image
+from common import ROOT, CRS, transform
+
+URL='https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/thredds/ncss/grid/regional/miami_13_navd88_2015.nc'
+PARAMS=dict(var='Band1',north=25.822,south=25.738,west=-80.212,east=-80.120,horizStride=1,accept='netcdf')
+DEPTHS=np.array([0,.7,1.6,2.8,4.5,7,12,18])
+COLORS=np.array([[166,190,165],[154,184,163],[132,172,157],[111,160,151],
+                 [96,148,144],[81,133,134],[68,116,124],[63,108,117]],np.float32)
+
+def depth_at(n):
+    dst=np.empty((n,n),np.float32)
+    with rasterio.open(ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif') as ds:
+        reproject(rasterio.band(ds,1),dst,src_transform=ds.transform,src_crs=ds.crs,
+                  dst_transform=transform(n),dst_crs=CRS,resampling=Resampling.bilinear)
+    return np.maximum(-dst,0)
+
+def pigment(n):
+    depth=depth_at(n)
+    return np.stack([np.interp(depth,DEPTHS,COLORS[:,k]) for k in range(3)],-1).astype(np.float32)
+
+def main():
+    raw=ROOT/'raw/round3/miami-bathy-subset.nc';raw.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    if not raw.exists():
+        r=requests.get(URL,params=PARAMS,timeout=120);r.raise_for_status();raw.write_bytes(r.content)
+    with netcdf_file(raw,mmap=False) as f:
+        lon=f.variables['lon'][:].copy();lat=f.variables['lat'][:].copy()
+        a=f.variables['Band1'][:].copy()[::-1].astype(np.float32)
+    dx=float(np.median(np.diff(lon)));dy=float(np.median(np.diff(lat)))
+    assert abs(dx-1/10800)<1e-9 and abs(dy-1/10800)<1e-9
+    tx=Affine(dx,0,float(lon[0]-dx/2),0,-dy,float(lat[-1]+dy/2))
+    dest=ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif';dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    with rasterio.open(dest,'w',driver='GTiff',height=a.shape[0],width=a.shape[1],count=1,
+                       dtype='float32',crs='EPSG:4326',transform=tx,nodata=-99999,
+                       compress='deflate',predictor=3) as ds:ds.write(a,1)
+    p=ROOT/'reports/round3/bathymetry-source.json'
+    log=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}
+    log.update(url=requests.Request('GET',URL,params=PARAMS).prepare().url,
+        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=raw.stat().st_size,
+        subset_shape=list(a.shape),coordinate_array_bounds=[float(lon[0]),float(lat[0]),float(lon[-1]),float(lat[-1])],
+        corrected_georeference='Pixel centres from lon/lat arrays, WGS84 per NOAA documentation. Ignore stale full-grid actual_range and spherical grid_mapping.',
+        retained_geotiff_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
+    d=depth_at(1024);w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'references/z0/surface_water.png'))>0
+    log['water_depth_percentiles_m_below_navd88']=np.percentile(d[w],[0,5,25,50,75,95,100]).tolist()
+    log['zero_or_above_datum_fraction_on_tiger_water']=float(np.mean(d[w]==0))
+    p.write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+    prior=ROOT/'raw/round3/prior'
+    for z in range(4):
+        kept=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png'
+        if not kept.exists():kept.write_bytes((prior/f'z{z}-final-master.png').read_bytes())
+    im=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'paintings/z0/retained-paint.png'))
+    im[w]=np.uint8(pigment(1024)[w]);Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/'reports/round3/depth-guide.png')
+    print(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Share broad wash differences, then draw saved stories and cut 85 exact tiles."""
+import json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from common import ROOT
+from round3_symbols import wrecks
+
+def blur(a,s=8):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+def scores(images):
+    return [float(np.abs(blur(cv2.resize(images[z+1],(len(images[z]),)*2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)-images[z])).mean()) for z in range(3)]
+
+def main():
+    images=[np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png'),np.float32) for z in range(4)]
+    log=dict(method='Symmetric continuous-canvas RGB broad-wash relaxation; sigma 8 parent pixels; no resampling of native ink.',initial=scores(images),passes=[])
+    print('initial',log['initial'],flush=True)
+    for step in range(10):
+        for z in ([2,1,0] if step%2==0 else [0,1,2]):
+            parent=images[z];child=images[z+1];n=len(parent)
+            small=cv2.resize(child,(n,n),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            field=np.clip(blur(small-parent),-10,10)
+            parent+=field*.46
+            for k in range(3):child[...,k]-=cv2.resize(field[...,k],(n*2,n*2),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)*.54
+            np.clip(parent,0,255,out=parent);np.clip(child,0,255,out=child)
+        err=scores(images);log['passes'].append(err);print('pass',step+1,err,flush=True)
+        if max(err)<1.65:break
+    for z,a in enumerate(images):
+        im=wrecks(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(a),0,255))),z)
+        im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):im.crop((x*1024,y*1024,(x+1)*1024,(y+1)*1024)).save(ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}/{x}_{y}.png')
+        im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(ROOT/f'reports/round3/z{z}-final.png')
+        print('export',z,flush=True)
+    log['final_float']=scores(images)
+    (ROOT/'reports/round3/balance.json').write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Audit exported RGB, every join, retained world data, and native brush detail.
+
+The visual review remains separate. No drawing-support identity is presented
+as an independent visible-geometry measurement.
+"""
+import hashlib, json
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from scipy.stats import spearmanr
+from common import ROOT
+from audit import png_info
+from round3_bathy import depth_at
+
+R=ROOT/'reports/round3'
+def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def blur(a,s):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+
+def main():
+    report={'time_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'zooms':{},'joins':[],
+        'interpretation':'Visible RGB diagnostics and complete delivery audit. Pigment is not a semantic map; artistic quality is assessed in REPORT.md.'}
+    hashes={}
+    for z in range(4):
+        n=1024*2**z;master=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png'
+        a=np.array(Image.open(master));stitch=np.empty_like(a)
+        expected={f'{x}_{y}.png' for x in range(2**z) for y in range(2**z)}
+        assert expected=={p.name for p in (ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}').glob('*.png')}
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):
+                p=ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}/{x}_{y}.png';im=Image.open(p)
+                assert im.mode=='RGB' and im.size==(1024,1024)
+                stitch[y*1024:(y+1)*1024,x*1024:(x+1)*1024]=im
+                hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+                for ext in ['raw.png','prompt.txt']:assert (ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.{ext}').exists()
+        item=dict(tiles=4**z,pixels=n,reconstruction_max=int(np.abs(a.astype(np.int16)-stitch).max()))
+        assert item['reconstruction_max']==0
+        for axis in ['vertical','horizontal']:
+            v=a if axis=='vertical' else a.transpose(1,0,2)
+            for k in range(1,2**z):
+                c=k*1024
+                for j in range(2**z):
+                    s=v[j*1024:(j+1)*1024,c-33:c+34].astype(np.int16)
+                    jumps=np.abs(np.diff(s,axis=1)).mean((0,2))
+                    cross=float(jumps[32]);adjacent=float((jumps[31]+jumps[33])/2)
+                    near=float(np.delete(jumps,32).mean())
+                    report['joins'].append(dict(z=z,axis=axis,coordinate=c,segment=j,jump=cross,immediate_neighbours=adjacent,
+                        ratio_immediate=cross/max(adjacent,.0001),nearby_66_boundaries=near,ratio_nearby=cross/max(near,.0001)))
+        if z:
+            p=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z-1}/final-master.png'),np.float32)
+            small=np.array(Image.fromarray(a).resize((n//2,n//2),Image.Resampling.BOX),np.float32)
+            delta=small-p
+            item['parent_rgb_mae_255']={'raw':float(np.abs(delta).mean()),'blur4':float(np.abs(blur(delta,4)).mean()),'blur8':float(np.abs(blur(delta,8)).mean()),
+                                      'blur16':float(np.abs(blur(delta,16)).mean()),'mean_shift':delta.mean((0,1)).tolist()}
+        w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+        af=a.astype(np.float32)
+        observed=(af[...,1]-af[...,0]>3)&(af[...,2]-af[...,0]>-18)
+        item['water_pigment']={'fixed_round2_classifier_iou':float((observed&w).sum()/(observed|w).sum()),
+            'source_water_fraction_classified':float(observed[w].mean()),'source_land_fraction_classified_as_teal':float(observed[~w].mean())}
+        edge=w&~nd.binary_erosion(w,border_value=1);edge[[0,-1]]=False;edge[:,[0,-1]]=False
+        oe=observed&~nd.binary_erosion(observed,border_value=1)
+        dist=nd.distance_transform_edt(~oe)[edge]
+        item['shore_pigment_proximity']={'mean_px':float(dist.mean()),'p95_px':float(np.percentile(dist,95)),
+            'max_px':float(dist.max()),'within_2_px':float((dist<=2).mean()),'limit':'One-way proximity to teal pigment, not a proof of survey accuracy.'}
+        # Retained z3 water and building drawing: inspect local contrast, rather
+        # than treating changed broad depth colour as lost native illustration.
+        if z>=2:
+            old=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png'),np.float32)
+            gray=af.mean(2);og=old.mean(2)
+            hp=gray-blur(gray,2);ohp=og-blur(og,2)
+            b=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/buildings.png'))>0
+            safe=nd.binary_erosion(w,iterations=8)
+            item['retained_native_drawing']={}
+            for label,mask in [('buildings',b),('water',safe)]:
+                x=hp[mask][::8];y=ohp[mask][::8]
+                item['retained_native_drawing'][label]=dict(highpass_correlation=float(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]),
+                    highpass_std_ratio=float(x.std()/max(y.std(),.001)))
+            del old,hp,ohp
+        # An overview statistic for depth relationships; this is not navigation.
+        overview=np.array(Image.fromarray(a).resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.BOX),np.float32)
+        ow=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'references/z0/surface_water.png'))>0
+        safe=nd.binary_erosion(ow,iterations=6)
+        lum=blur(overview.mean(2),8);dep=depth_at(1024)
+        item['depth_vs_darkness_rank_correlation']=float(spearmanr(dep[safe][::8],-lum[safe][::8]).statistic)
+        report['zooms'][str(z)]=item
+        print(z,'parent',item.get('parent_rgb_mae_255'),'water',item['water_pigment'],flush=True)
+    assert len(report['joins'])==140
+    report['join_count']=len(report['joins'])
+    report['join_max_immediate']=max(x['ratio_immediate'] for x in report['joins'])
+    report['join_max_nearby']=max(x['ratio_nearby'] for x in report['joins'])
+    prior=json.loads((R/'prior-sha256.json').read_text())
+    preserved={}
+    for key,h in prior.items():
+        if key.startswith('base/') and key!='base/VALUES.md':
+            preserved[key]=sha(ROOT/key)==h;assert preserved[key],key
+    report['existing_base_unchanged']=preserved
+    for z in range(4):
+        originals=list((ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}').glob('*.raw.png'))
+        assert len(originals)==4**z
+        for p in originals:hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    report['originals_changed']=[k for k,h in hashes.items() if k.endswith('.raw.png') and prior.get(k)!=h]
+    report['z3_originals_unchanged']=all(hashes[k]==h for k,h in prior.items() if k.startswith('paintings/z3/') and k.endswith('.raw.png'))
+    assert report['z3_originals_unchanged']
+    for p in (ROOT/'base').glob('*.png'):
+        info=png_info(p);n=8192 if p.stem.endswith('_fine') else 4065
+        assert info['width']==info['height']==n and info['color_type']==0
+        assert info['bit_depth']==(16 if p.name=='height.png' else 8)
+    report['engine_corners']={name:[4064-e,4064+n] for name,e,n in [('NW',-4064,4064),('NE',4064,4064),('SE',4064,-4064),('SW',-4064,-4064)]}
+    for folder in ['base','style']:
+        for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob('*'):
+            if p.is_file():hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    for p in (ROOT/'paintings').rglob('*'):
+        if p.is_file() and (p.name.endswith('.prompt.txt') or p.name in ['retained-paint.png','water-parent.png']):hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
+    (R/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
+    (R/'sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,indent=2))
+    print('PASS: 85 tiles, 85 originals, 140 joins, zero cut error, original world layers unchanged.',flush=True)
+    print('worst immediate / neighborhood',report['join_max_immediate'],report['join_max_nearby'],flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Four different drawn wreck stories, at the four frozen world hulls.
+
+Far symbols exaggerate size (as round two did), never position or direction.
+Close symbols use the source length/beam. All internal salvage detail is fiction.
+"""
+import math
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from common import vectors, SIZE
+
+def wrecks(im,z):
+    mpp=SIZE/im.width;s=4
+    for g,p in vectors('future_changes'):
+        if p['kind']!='submerged_wreck':continue
+        length=max(p['length_m']/mpp,17 if z==0 else 22 if z==1 else 0)
+        width=max(p['width_m']/mpp,5.5 if z==0 else 7 if z==1 else 0)
+        side=math.ceil(length+width+12);sheet=Image.new('RGBA',(side*s,side*s));d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
+        angle=-math.radians(p['angle_degrees'])
+        def q(u,v):
+            x=u*length;y=v*width
+            return ((side/2+x*math.cos(angle)-y*math.sin(angle))*s,(side/2+x*math.sin(angle)+y*math.cos(angle))*s)
+        ink=(67,91,80,210);pale=(199,195,151,230);rust=(142,108,69,210);wash=(91,126,113,170)
+        k=p['id']
+        hull=[(-.49,0),(-.36,-.43),(.28,-.46),(.5,0),(.28,.44),(-.36,.43)]
+        if k==1:hull=[(-.48,-.38),(.35,-.38),(.48,-.18),(.48,.32),(-.48,.38)]
+        d.polygon([q(*a) for a in hull],fill=wash)
+        d.line([q(*a) for a in hull[:4]],fill=ink,width=2)
+        d.line([q(*a) for a in hull[4:]+[hull[0]]],fill=ink,width=2)
+        if k==0:
+            # Broken cargo spine; the two halves no longer share a straight keel.
+            for i,u in enumerate([-.30,-.18,-.05,.13,.26]):
+                d.line([q(u,-.32),q(u+.025,.29 if i!=2 else -.02)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.35,0),q(-.09,0)],fill=rust,width=3)
+            d.line([q(.06,.09),q(.32,.09)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        elif k==1:
+            # Low barge, two empty square holds and one folded wall.
+            for u in [-.22,.12]:
+                d.line([q(u-.1,-.23),q(u+.1,-.23),q(u+.1,.20),q(u-.1,.20),q(u-.1,-.23)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.38,.34),q(-.16,.08)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        elif k==2:
+            # Little working hull, offset broken cabin and bare stern.
+            d.line([q(-.15,-.25),q(.10,-.25),q(.1,.21),q(-.15,.21),q(-.15,-.25)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(.12,0),q(.35,-.22)],fill=rust,width=3)
+            d.line([q(-.35,-.25),q(-.35,.25)],fill=pale,width=2)
+        else:
+            # Narrow rib cage with a missing side and a fallen mast.
+            for u in [-.25,-.06,.13,.29]:d.line([q(u,-.33),q(u,.32)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.1,-.38),q(.32,.14)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        sheet=sheet.resize((side,side),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+        cx=(p['center'][0]+4064)/mpp;cy=(4064-p['center'][1])/mpp
+        im.paste(sheet,(round(cx-side/2),round(cy-side/2)),sheet)
+    return im

+## Current delivery: round three
+
+Round three keeps the accepted room paintings and most distant land, repaints
+water at its own scales, and adds distinct far landmark pictures. A retained
+round-two finish at each scale is a deliberate production input, verified
+against all 85 pre-change tiles. This avoids re-rendering accepted land through
+a changed pipeline. New z0/z1 originals supply selected land and water; 15 new
+z2 originals supply water; z2 `0_0` and all 64 z3 originals remain unchanged.
+
+Reproduce the delivered artwork offline from kept files, with no image calls,
+network request, or git access:
+
+```sh
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/reference.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 0
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 1
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 2
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 3
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_export.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_measure.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_review.py
+```
+
+| Tool | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| round3_bathy.py | Download the exact NOAA coastal DEM subset if needed; read true coordinate arrays instead of stale regional bounding attributes; freeze a lossless georeferenced Float32 subset; render the initial depth guide. Not needed for offline finishing when the retained GeoTIFF exists. |
+| round3_contexts.py | Prepare the 15 new native z2 painting contexts and their prompts. Generation only; uses the frozen z1 generation-time parent. |
+| round3.py Z | Assemble/align the new originals, preserve accepted land outside local story selections, constrain broad water pigment to observed depth, keep native brush marks, and replace the far mainland mechanical coast trace. Writes continuous unbalanced masters. |
+| round3_symbols.py | Four individual wreck interiors, keeping saved centres and bearings; size exaggeration only at z0/z1. |
+| round3_export.py | Symmetric broad wash calibration, wrecks, and exact 1,024² tile cuts. No tile-edge retouch. |
+| round3_measure.py | Every join, exact reconstruction, broad RGB differences at three blur radii, fixed water-pigment classification, base integrity, original inventory and retained native-detail correlations. |
+| round3_review.py | Round-two/three comparison, all zooms, all tile contact sheets, landmark/coast details, worst joins and a marker-overlay study. All review evidence is under reports/round3/. |
+
+`paintings/z*/retained-paint.png` is kept artwork, not an ignored intermediate.
+`paintings/z1/water-parent.png` and `reports/round3/z0-registered-study.png` record
+generation-time parents. New exact prompts are beside the replaced originals.
+The existing registration-image caches remain ignored; the finishing result
+must be identical with or without them. `base/bathymetry/README.md` explains the
+depth datum and the distinction between observed underwater forms and artistic
+wash. No data or engine coordinate convention from round two is replaced.

+New generated originals supply the native hand. Bathymetry controls the broad

+"""
+import argparse, json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from common import ROOT, SIZE, vectors
+from round2 import far_register, assemble_far, wet, major_roads, INK
+from round3_bathy import pigment
+from finish import load
+
+R=ROOT/'reports/round3'
+# Soft editorial selection, in overview pixels. Pictorial symbols, not world
+# footprint additions. Far diagrams only; z2/z3 retain all source-bound rooms.
+PLACES=[('banyan_arcade',125,241,100,86),('drowned_towers',172,447,90,115),
+        ('reed_bowl',208,554,62,56),('deco_gallery',915,479,72,70),
+        ('tank_grove',714,925,87,72),('belle_loggia',737,355,37,34)]
+
+def far_land_mask(n):
+    y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n].astype(np.float32);x*=1024/n;y*=1024/n
+    mask=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+    for _,cx,cy,rx,ry in PLACES:
+        r=np.sqrt(((x-cx)/rx)**2+((y-cy)/ry)**2)
+        mask=np.maximum(mask,np.clip((1-r)/.18,0,1))
+    return mask
+
+def register(z):
+    n=1024*2**z;w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    cache=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/round3.registered.png'
+    if cache.exists():return load(cache)
+    if z==0:
+        a,info=far_register(load(ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.raw.png',(n,n)),w)
+        (R/'z0-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+        (ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+    elif z==1:a=assemble_far(z,w)
+    else:
+        from alignment import shore_align
+        g=64;s=1152;a=np.zeros((n,n,3),np.float32);total=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+        ramp=np.ones(s,np.float32);ramp[:128]=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,128))**2;ramp[-128:]=ramp[:128][::-1]
+        weight=ramp[:,None]*ramp[None,:];padded=np.pad(w,g,mode='edge');logs={}
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):
+                source=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.raw.png',(s,s))
+                source_water=(source[...,1]-source[...,0]>1)&(source[...,2]-source[...,0]>-48)
+                tile,info=shore_align(source,padded[y*1024:y*1024+s,x*1024:x*1024+s],source_water)
+                logs[f'{x}_{y}']=info
+                (ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+                xa=max(0,x*1024-g);xb=min(n,(x+1)*1024+g);ya=max(0,y*1024-g);yb=min(n,(y+1)*1024+g)
+                u=xa-(x*1024-g);v=ya-(y*1024-g);q=weight[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]
+                a[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=tile[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]*q[...,None];total[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=q
+                print('registered water',x,y,flush=True)
+        a/=np.maximum(total[...,None],.0001)
+        (R/'z2-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs,indent=2))
+    Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(a,0,255))).save(cache)
+    # Read the same frozen precision used on cache hits; cache existence must
+    # never change the exported artwork by a rounding unit.
+    return load(cache)
+
+def extend_water(raw,w):
+    """Nearest safe pigment only for misregistered coast / erroneous margin.
+
+    This does not soften an entire coast or invent a luminous shore-distance
+    field. The source strokes survive throughout correctly painted water.
+    """
+    # Pale green shoals are still water. The older open-teal classifier would
+    # wrongly erase them and form conspicuous nearest-neighbour polygons.
+    source=(raw[...,1]-raw[...,0]>1)&(raw[...,2]-raw[...,0]>-48)
+    bad=w&~source
+    a=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(raw,0,255)),bad.astype(np.uint8),5,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(np.float32)
+    return a
+
+def paint_water(raw,w,z):
+    n=len(w);guide=pigment(n)
+    # Slightly soften the ten-metre DEM's interpolation facets, not the shore.
+    guide=nd.gaussian_filter(guide,(.8*2**z,.8*2**z,0))
+    a=raw if z==3 else extend_water(raw,w)
+    # Normalized filtering avoids dark shore ink or ivory land making halos.
+    sigma=12 if z<2 else 22
+    den=nd.gaussian_filter(w.astype(np.float32),sigma)
+    out=guide.copy()
+    for k in range(3):
+        broad=nd.gaussian_filter(a[...,k]*w,sigma)/np.maximum(den,.0001)
+        detail=a[...,k]-broad
+        if z<3:detail=np.clip(detail,-24,24)
+        if z<=2:
+            # Keep the fresh quill/wash marks. Data, not generated contour drift,
+            # carries all low-frequency depth structure.
+            bias=np.clip(broad-guide[...,k],-10,10)*.3
+            out[...,k]+=detail*.80+bias
+        else:
+            # Existing fine watercolor is accepted: change its large wash only.
+            out[...,k]+=detail
+    return out
+
+def living_coast(out,w,z):
+    """Trace real vectors with a subpixel pen; no staircase or regular dashes."""
+    if z>1:return out
+    n=len(w);s=3
+    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(n*s,n*s));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    from shapely.ops import unary_union
+    # TIGER splits one continuous bay into records. Their internal boundaries
+    # are NOT coast and must never become ink strokes across the sea.
+    for g in [unary_union([g for g,p in vectors('areawater')])]:
+        polys=list(g.geoms) if g.geom_type=='MultiPolygon' else [g]
+        for poly in polys:
+            for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]:
+                pts=np.array(ring.coords,np.float64)
+                px=np.stack([(pts[:,0]+4064)/SIZE*n,(4064-pts[:,1])/SIZE*n],-1)
+                phase=0.
+                for q0,q1 in zip(px[:-1],px[1:]):
+                    delta=q1-q0;length=np.linalg.norm(delta)
+                    if length<.1:continue
+                    normal=np.array([-delta[1],delta[0]])/length
+                    for t in np.arange(0,length,1.5):
+                        tt=min(t+1.6,length);pos=phase+t
+                        # Continuous bounded irregular pen pressure, not dots.
+                        strength=.47+.18*np.sin(pos*.13)+.12*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                        width=.55+.20*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        j0=.45*np.sin(pos*.61)+.18*np.sin(pos*1.31)
+                        j1=.45*np.sin((phase+tt)*.61)+.18*np.sin((phase+tt)*1.31)
+                        a=q0+delta*t/length+normal*j0;b=q0+delta*tt/length+normal*j1
+                        # Beaches retain the original delicate treatment.
+                        u,v=a/n
+                        if u<.29 and v<.66:
+                            strength=.82+.16*np.sin(pos*.13)+.10*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                            width=1.03+.35*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        if u>.91 or v>.82 and u>.49:strength*=.32
+                        if min(a)<1 or max(a)>n-2:continue
+                        d.line([tuple(a*s),tuple(b*s)],fill=(76,78,53,int(210*strength)),width=max(1,round(width*s)))
+                    phase+=length
+    layer=layer.resize((n,n),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+    return np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255))).convert('RGBA'),layer).convert('RGB'),np.float32)
+
+def finish(z):
+    n=1024*2**z
+    print('load accepted paint',z,flush=True)
+    old=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png')
+    w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    rd=major_roads(z,n)
+    print('native masks ready',z,flush=True)
+    raw=register(z) if z<3 else old
+    out=old.copy()
+    if z<2:
+        mask=far_land_mask(n)*(~w)
+        # Keep every principal road at its native source alignment.
+        mask[rd]=0
+        land=raw.copy()
+        wrong=(~w)&wet(raw)&(nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)<14)
+        land[wrong]=old[wrong]
+        out=out*(1-mask[...,None])+land*mask[...,None]
+    print('paint water',z,flush=True)
+    wp=paint_water(raw,w,z);out[w]=wp[w]
+    print('water ready',z,flush=True)
+    # Accepted crane arms project beyond the port's physical land silhouette.
+    # Retain those warm ink marks, not a new strip of land beneath the cranes.
+    if z<2:
+        yy,xx=np.mgrid[:n,:n]
+        port=(xx/n>.30)&(xx/n<.77)&(yy/n>.45)&(yy/n<.66)
+        crane=port&w&(old[...,0]-old[...,1]>2)&(old[...,1]-old[...,2]>12)&(old.mean(2)<205)
+        out[crane]=old[crane]
+    if z<2:
+        # Remove the old mechanical double shore trace on the mainland only.
+        dw=nd.distance_transform_edt(w);dl=nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)
+        y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n];mainland=(x/n<.29)&(y/n<.66)
+        band=mainland&~w&(dl<3.8)&~rd
+        if band.any():
+            mask=band.astype(np.uint8)
+            repaired=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)),mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
+            out[band]=repaired[band]
+    out=living_coast(out,w,z)
+    im=Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)))
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png')
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+    im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(R/f'z{z}-study.png')
+    print('round3 finish',z,flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('zoom',type=int);a=p.parse_args();finish(a.zoom)

+"""Acquire and freeze NOAA bathymetry; render a depth guide, never a new coast.
+
+The NCSS response retains the full dataset's stale actual_range attributes.
+Read lon/lat coordinate arrays explicitly. NOAA identifies the horizontal datum
+as WGS84; the inconsistent spherical grid_mapping attribute is not used.
+"""
+import hashlib, json
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import requests
+import numpy as np
+import rasterio
+from rasterio.warp import reproject, Resampling
+from affine import Affine
+from scipy.io import netcdf_file
+from PIL import Image
+from common import ROOT, CRS, transform
+
+URL='https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/thredds/ncss/grid/regional/miami_13_navd88_2015.nc'
+PARAMS=dict(var='Band1',north=25.822,south=25.738,west=-80.212,east=-80.120,horizStride=1,accept='netcdf')
+DEPTHS=np.array([0,.7,1.6,2.8,4.5,7,12,18])
+COLORS=np.array([[166,190,165],[154,184,163],[132,172,157],[111,160,151],
+                 [96,148,144],[81,133,134],[68,116,124],[63,108,117]],np.float32)
+
+def depth_at(n):
+    dst=np.empty((n,n),np.float32)
+    with rasterio.open(ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif') as ds:
+        reproject(rasterio.band(ds,1),dst,src_transform=ds.transform,src_crs=ds.crs,
+                  dst_transform=transform(n),dst_crs=CRS,resampling=Resampling.bilinear)
+    return np.maximum(-dst,0)
+
+def pigment(n):
+    depth=depth_at(n)
+    return np.stack([np.interp(depth,DEPTHS,COLORS[:,k]) for k in range(3)],-1).astype(np.float32)
+
+def main():
+    raw=ROOT/'raw/round3/miami-bathy-subset.nc';raw.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    if not raw.exists():
+        r=requests.get(URL,params=PARAMS,timeout=120);r.raise_for_status();raw.write_bytes(r.content)
+    with netcdf_file(raw,mmap=False) as f:
+        lon=f.variables['lon'][:].copy();lat=f.variables['lat'][:].copy()
+        a=f.variables['Band1'][:].copy()[::-1].astype(np.float32)
+    dx=float(np.median(np.diff(lon)));dy=float(np.median(np.diff(lat)))
+    assert abs(dx-1/10800)<1e-9 and abs(dy-1/10800)<1e-9
+    tx=Affine(dx,0,float(lon[0]-dx/2),0,-dy,float(lat[-1]+dy/2))
+    dest=ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif';dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    with rasterio.open(dest,'w',driver='GTiff',height=a.shape[0],width=a.shape[1],count=1,
+                       dtype='float32',crs='EPSG:4326',transform=tx,nodata=-99999,
+                       compress='deflate',predictor=3) as ds:ds.write(a,1)
+    p=ROOT/'reports/round3/bathymetry-source.json'
+    log=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}
+    log.update(url=requests.Request('GET',URL,params=PARAMS).prepare().url,
+        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=raw.stat().st_size,
+        subset_shape=list(a.shape),coordinate_array_bounds=[float(lon[0]),float(lat[0]),float(lon[-1]),float(lat[-1])],
+        corrected_georeference='Pixel centres from lon/lat arrays, WGS84 per NOAA documentation. Ignore stale full-grid actual_range and spherical grid_mapping.',
+        retained_geotiff_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
+    d=depth_at(1024);w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'references/z0/surface_water.png'))>0
+    log['water_depth_percentiles_m_below_navd88']=np.percentile(d[w],[0,5,25,50,75,95,100]).tolist()
+    log['zero_or_above_datum_fraction_on_tiger_water']=float(np.mean(d[w]==0))
+    p.write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+    prior=ROOT/'raw/round3/prior'
+    for z in range(4):
+        kept=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png'
+        if not kept.exists():kept.write_bytes((prior/f'z{z}-final-master.png').read_bytes())
+    im=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'paintings/z0/retained-paint.png'))
+    im[w]=np.uint8(pigment(1024)[w]);Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/'reports/round3/depth-guide.png')
+    print(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Share broad wash differences, then draw saved stories and cut 85 exact tiles."""
+import json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from common import ROOT
+from round3_symbols import wrecks
+
+def blur(a,s=8):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+def scores(images):
+    return [float(np.abs(blur(cv2.resize(images[z+1],(len(images[z]),)*2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)-images[z])).mean()) for z in range(3)]
+
+def main():
+    images=[np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png'),np.float32) for z in range(4)]
+    log=dict(method='Symmetric continuous-canvas RGB broad-wash relaxation; sigma 8 parent pixels; no resampling of native ink.',initial=scores(images),passes=[])
+    print('initial',log['initial'],flush=True)
+    for step in range(10):
+        for z in ([2,1,0] if step%2==0 else [0,1,2]):
+            parent=images[z];child=images[z+1];n=len(parent)
+            small=cv2.resize(child,(n,n),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+            field=np.clip(blur(small-parent),-10,10)
+            parent+=field*.46
+            for k in range(3):child[...,k]-=cv2.resize(field[...,k],(n*2,n*2),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)*.54
+            np.clip(parent,0,255,out=parent);np.clip(child,0,255,out=child)
+        err=scores(images);log['passes'].append(err);print('pass',step+1,err,flush=True)
+        if max(err)<1.65:break
+    for z,a in enumerate(images):
+        im=wrecks(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(a),0,255))),z)
+        im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):im.crop((x*1024,y*1024,(x+1)*1024,(y+1)*1024)).save(ROOT/f'tiles/z{z}/{x}_{y}.png')
+        im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(ROOT/f'reports/round3/z{z}-final.png')
+        print('export',z,flush=True)
+    log['final_float']=scores(images)
+    (ROOT/'reports/round3/balance.json').write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+"""Audit exported RGB, every join, retained world data, and native brush detail.
+
+The visual review remains separate. No drawing-support identity is presented
+as an independent visible-geometry measurement.
+"""
+import hashlib, json
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from scipy.stats import spearmanr
+from common import ROOT
+from audit import png_info
+from round3_bathy import depth_at
+

+def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def blur(a,s):return cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),s,borderType=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
+
+def main():
+    report={'time_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'zooms':{},'joins':[],
+        'interpretation':'Visible RGB diagnostics and complete delivery audit. Pigment is not a semantic map; artistic quality is assessed in REPORT.md.'}
+    hashes={}
+    for z in range(4):

+def wrecks(im,z):
+    mpp=SIZE/im.width;s=4
+    for g,p in vectors('future_changes'):
+        if p['kind']!='submerged_wreck':continue
+        length=max(p['length_m']/mpp,17 if z==0 else 22 if z==1 else 0)

+        angle=-math.radians(p['angle_degrees'])
+        def q(u,v):
+            x=u*length;y=v*width
+            return ((side/2+x*math.cos(angle)-y*math.sin(angle))*s,(side/2+x*math.sin(angle)+y*math.cos(angle))*s)
+        ink=(67,91,80,210);pale=(199,195,151,230);rust=(142,108,69,210);wash=(91,126,113,170)
+        k=p['id']

+        d.polygon([q(*a) for a in hull],fill=wash)

+        d.line([q(*a) for a in hull[4:]+[hull[0]]],fill=ink,width=2)
+        if k==0:
+            # Broken cargo spine; the two halves no longer share a straight keel.
+            for i,u in enumerate([-.30,-.18,-.05,.13,.26]):
+                d.line([q(u,-.32),q(u+.025,.29 if i!=2 else -.02)],fill=pale,width=2)
+            d.line([q(-.35,0),q(-.09,0)],fill=rust,width=3)
+            d.line([q(.06,.09),q(.32,.09)],fill=rust,width=3)
+        elif k==1:
+            # Low barge, two empty square holds and one folded wall.
+            for u in [-.22,.12]:

 Offline source/art tools only. They add no dependency to the engine or its build.
 
-## Current delivery: round two
+## Current delivery: round three
+
+Round three keeps the accepted room paintings and most distant land, repaints
+water at its own scales, and adds distinct far landmark pictures. A retained
+round-two finish at each scale is a deliberate production input, verified
+against all 85 pre-change tiles. This avoids re-rendering accepted land through
+a changed pipeline. New z0/z1 originals supply selected land and water; 15 new
+z2 originals supply water; z2 `0_0` and all 64 z3 originals remain unchanged.
+
+Reproduce the delivered artwork offline from kept files, with no image calls,
+network request, or git access:
+
+```sh
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/reference.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 0
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 1
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 2
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3.py 3
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_export.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_measure.py
+tools/mapart/.venv/bin/python tools/mapart/round3_review.py
+```
+
+| Tool | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| round3_bathy.py | Download the exact NOAA coastal DEM subset if needed; read true coordinate arrays instead of stale regional bounding attributes; freeze a lossless georeferenced Float32 subset; render the initial depth guide. Not needed for offline finishing when the retained GeoTIFF exists. |
+| round3_contexts.py | Prepare the 15 new native z2 painting contexts and their prompts. Generation only; uses the frozen z1 generation-time parent. |
+| round3.py Z | Assemble/align the new originals, preserve accepted land outside local story selections, constrain broad water pigment to observed depth, keep native brush marks, and replace the far mainland mechanical coast trace. Writes continuous unbalanced masters. |
+| round3_symbols.py | Four individual wreck interiors, keeping saved centres and bearings; size exaggeration only at z0/z1. |
+| round3_export.py | Symmetric broad wash calibration, wrecks, and exact 1,024² tile cuts. No tile-edge retouch. |
+| round3_measure.py | Every join, exact reconstruction, broad RGB differences at three blur radii, fixed water-pigment classification, base integrity, original inventory and retained native-detail correlations. |
+| round3_review.py | Round-two/three comparison, all zooms, all tile contact sheets, landmark/coast details, worst joins and a marker-overlay study. All review evidence is under reports/round3/. |
+
+`paintings/z*/retained-paint.png` is kept artwork, not an ignored intermediate.
+`paintings/z1/water-parent.png` and `reports/round3/z0-registered-study.png` record
+generation-time parents. New exact prompts are beside the replaced originals.
+The existing registration-image caches remain ignored; the finishing result
+must be identical with or without them. `base/bathymetry/README.md` explains the
+depth datum and the distinction between observed underwater forms and artistic
+wash. No data or engine coordinate convention from round two is replaced.
+
+Do not use the round-one/two export entry points for the current delivery.
+
+## Historical delivery: round two
 
 The original geographic pipeline below remains authoritative for source layers. The current art finish is **round2.py**, followed by **round2_balance.py**. Do not use the old `finish.py` entry point to export the round-two delivery: its all-features-at-all-scales treatment is the artistic behavior replaced in this round. Its registration/overlap helpers are still used for the close original paintings.

+"""Round three: localized land pictures, painted data-led water, continuous cuts.
+
+Retained-paint.png is the frozen accepted round-two finish, a production input.
+New generated originals supply the native hand. Bathymetry controls the broad
+underwater structure; the existing source coast remains authoritative.
+"""
+import argparse, json
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from scipy import ndimage as nd
+from common import ROOT, SIZE, vectors
+from round2 import far_register, assemble_far, wet, major_roads, INK
+from round3_bathy import pigment
+from finish import load
+
+R=ROOT/'reports/round3'
+# Soft editorial selection, in overview pixels. Pictorial symbols, not world
+# footprint additions. Far diagrams only; z2/z3 retain all source-bound rooms.
+PLACES=[('banyan_arcade',125,241,100,86),('drowned_towers',172,447,90,115),
+        ('reed_bowl',208,554,62,56),('deco_gallery',915,479,72,70),
+        ('tank_grove',714,925,87,72),('belle_loggia',737,355,37,34)]
+
+def far_land_mask(n):
+    y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n].astype(np.float32);x*=1024/n;y*=1024/n
+    mask=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+    for _,cx,cy,rx,ry in PLACES:
+        r=np.sqrt(((x-cx)/rx)**2+((y-cy)/ry)**2)
+        mask=np.maximum(mask,np.clip((1-r)/.18,0,1))
+    return mask
+
+def register(z):
+    n=1024*2**z;w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    cache=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/round3.registered.png'
+    if cache.exists():return load(cache)
+    if z==0:
+        a,info=far_register(load(ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.raw.png',(n,n)),w)
+        (R/'z0-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+        (ROOT/'paintings/z0/0_0.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+    elif z==1:a=assemble_far(z,w)
+    else:
+        from alignment import shore_align
+        g=64;s=1152;a=np.zeros((n,n,3),np.float32);total=np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
+        ramp=np.ones(s,np.float32);ramp[:128]=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,128))**2;ramp[-128:]=ramp[:128][::-1]
+        weight=ramp[:,None]*ramp[None,:];padded=np.pad(w,g,mode='edge');logs={}
+        for y in range(2**z):
+            for x in range(2**z):
+                source=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.raw.png',(s,s))
+                source_water=(source[...,1]-source[...,0]>1)&(source[...,2]-source[...,0]>-48)
+                tile,info=shore_align(source,padded[y*1024:y*1024+s,x*1024:x*1024+s],source_water)
+                logs[f'{x}_{y}']=info
+                (ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/{x}_{y}.registered.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
+                xa=max(0,x*1024-g);xb=min(n,(x+1)*1024+g);ya=max(0,y*1024-g);yb=min(n,(y+1)*1024+g)
+                u=xa-(x*1024-g);v=ya-(y*1024-g);q=weight[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]
+                a[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=tile[v:v+yb-ya,u:u+xb-xa]*q[...,None];total[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=q
+                print('registered water',x,y,flush=True)
+        a/=np.maximum(total[...,None],.0001)
+        (R/'z2-registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs,indent=2))
+    Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(a,0,255))).save(cache)
+    # Read the same frozen precision used on cache hits; cache existence must
+    # never change the exported artwork by a rounding unit.
+    return load(cache)
+
+def extend_water(raw,w):
+    """Nearest safe pigment only for misregistered coast / erroneous margin.
+
+    This does not soften an entire coast or invent a luminous shore-distance
+    field. The source strokes survive throughout correctly painted water.
+    """
+    # Pale green shoals are still water. The older open-teal classifier would
+    # wrongly erase them and form conspicuous nearest-neighbour polygons.
+    source=(raw[...,1]-raw[...,0]>1)&(raw[...,2]-raw[...,0]>-48)
+    bad=w&~source
+    a=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(raw,0,255)),bad.astype(np.uint8),5,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(np.float32)
+    return a
+
+def paint_water(raw,w,z):
+    n=len(w);guide=pigment(n)
+    # Slightly soften the ten-metre DEM's interpolation facets, not the shore.
+    guide=nd.gaussian_filter(guide,(.8*2**z,.8*2**z,0))
+    a=raw if z==3 else extend_water(raw,w)
+    # Normalized filtering avoids dark shore ink or ivory land making halos.
+    sigma=12 if z<2 else 22
+    den=nd.gaussian_filter(w.astype(np.float32),sigma)
+    out=guide.copy()
+    for k in range(3):
+        broad=nd.gaussian_filter(a[...,k]*w,sigma)/np.maximum(den,.0001)
+        detail=a[...,k]-broad
+        if z<3:detail=np.clip(detail,-24,24)
+        if z<=2:
+            # Keep the fresh quill/wash marks. Data, not generated contour drift,
+            # carries all low-frequency depth structure.
+            bias=np.clip(broad-guide[...,k],-10,10)*.3
+            out[...,k]+=detail*.80+bias
+        else:
+            # Existing fine watercolor is accepted: change its large wash only.
+            out[...,k]+=detail
+    return out
+
+def living_coast(out,w,z):
+    """Trace real vectors with a subpixel pen; no staircase or regular dashes."""
+    if z>1:return out
+    n=len(w);s=3
+    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(n*s,n*s));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    from shapely.ops import unary_union
+    # TIGER splits one continuous bay into records. Their internal boundaries
+    # are NOT coast and must never become ink strokes across the sea.
+    for g in [unary_union([g for g,p in vectors('areawater')])]:
+        polys=list(g.geoms) if g.geom_type=='MultiPolygon' else [g]
+        for poly in polys:
+            for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]:
+                pts=np.array(ring.coords,np.float64)
+                px=np.stack([(pts[:,0]+4064)/SIZE*n,(4064-pts[:,1])/SIZE*n],-1)
+                phase=0.
+                for q0,q1 in zip(px[:-1],px[1:]):
+                    delta=q1-q0;length=np.linalg.norm(delta)
+                    if length<.1:continue
+                    normal=np.array([-delta[1],delta[0]])/length
+                    for t in np.arange(0,length,1.5):
+                        tt=min(t+1.6,length);pos=phase+t
+                        # Continuous bounded irregular pen pressure, not dots.
+                        strength=.47+.18*np.sin(pos*.13)+.12*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                        width=.55+.20*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        j0=.45*np.sin(pos*.61)+.18*np.sin(pos*1.31)
+                        j1=.45*np.sin((phase+tt)*.61)+.18*np.sin((phase+tt)*1.31)
+                        a=q0+delta*t/length+normal*j0;b=q0+delta*tt/length+normal*j1
+                        # Beaches retain the original delicate treatment.
+                        u,v=a/n
+                        if u<.29 and v<.66:
+                            strength=.82+.16*np.sin(pos*.13)+.10*np.sin(pos*.63+1.8)
+                            width=1.03+.35*np.sin(pos*.22+.4)
+                        if u>.91 or v>.82 and u>.49:strength*=.32
+                        if min(a)<1 or max(a)>n-2:continue
+                        d.line([tuple(a*s),tuple(b*s)],fill=(76,78,53,int(210*strength)),width=max(1,round(width*s)))
+                    phase+=length
+    layer=layer.resize((n,n),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+    return np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255))).convert('RGBA'),layer).convert('RGB'),np.float32)
+
+def finish(z):
+    n=1024*2**z
+    print('load accepted paint',z,flush=True)
+    old=load(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png')
+    w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/f'references/z{z}/surface_water.png'))>0
+    rd=major_roads(z,n)
+    print('native masks ready',z,flush=True)
+    raw=register(z) if z<3 else old
+    out=old.copy()
+    if z<2:
+        mask=far_land_mask(n)*(~w)
+        # Keep every principal road at its native source alignment.
+        mask[rd]=0
+        land=raw.copy()
+        wrong=(~w)&wet(raw)&(nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)<14)
+        land[wrong]=old[wrong]
+        out=out*(1-mask[...,None])+land*mask[...,None]
+    print('paint water',z,flush=True)
+    wp=paint_water(raw,w,z);out[w]=wp[w]
+    print('water ready',z,flush=True)
+    # Accepted crane arms project beyond the port's physical land silhouette.
+    # Retain those warm ink marks, not a new strip of land beneath the cranes.
+    if z<2:
+        yy,xx=np.mgrid[:n,:n]
+        port=(xx/n>.30)&(xx/n<.77)&(yy/n>.45)&(yy/n<.66)
+        crane=port&w&(old[...,0]-old[...,1]>2)&(old[...,1]-old[...,2]>12)&(old.mean(2)<205)
+        out[crane]=old[crane]
+    if z<2:
+        # Remove the old mechanical double shore trace on the mainland only.
+        dw=nd.distance_transform_edt(w);dl=nd.distance_transform_edt(~w)
+        y,x=np.mgrid[:n,:n];mainland=(x/n<.29)&(y/n<.66)
+        band=mainland&~w&(dl<3.8)&~rd
+        if band.any():
+            mask=band.astype(np.uint8)
+            repaired=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)),mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
+            out[band]=repaired[band]
+    out=living_coast(out,w,z)
+    im=Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)))
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/unbalanced-master.png')
+    im.save(ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/final-master.png')
+    im.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(R/f'z{z}-study.png')
+    print('round3 finish',z,flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('zoom',type=int);a=p.parse_args();finish(a.zoom)

+DEPTHS=np.array([0,.7,1.6,2.8,4.5,7,12,18])
+COLORS=np.array([[166,190,165],[154,184,163],[132,172,157],[111,160,151],
+                 [96,148,144],[81,133,134],[68,116,124],[63,108,117]],np.float32)
+
+def depth_at(n):
+    dst=np.empty((n,n),np.float32)
+    with rasterio.open(ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif') as ds:
+        reproject(rasterio.band(ds,1),dst,src_transform=ds.transform,src_crs=ds.crs,
+                  dst_transform=transform(n),dst_crs=CRS,resampling=Resampling.bilinear)
+    return np.maximum(-dst,0)
+
+def pigment(n):
+    depth=depth_at(n)
+    return np.stack([np.interp(depth,DEPTHS,COLORS[:,k]) for k in range(3)],-1).astype(np.float32)
+
+def main():
+    raw=ROOT/'raw/round3/miami-bathy-subset.nc';raw.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    if not raw.exists():
+        r=requests.get(URL,params=PARAMS,timeout=120);r.raise_for_status();raw.write_bytes(r.content)
+    with netcdf_file(raw,mmap=False) as f:
+        lon=f.variables['lon'][:].copy();lat=f.variables['lat'][:].copy()
+        a=f.variables['Band1'][:].copy()[::-1].astype(np.float32)
+    dx=float(np.median(np.diff(lon)));dy=float(np.median(np.diff(lat)))
+    assert abs(dx-1/10800)<1e-9 and abs(dy-1/10800)<1e-9
+    tx=Affine(dx,0,float(lon[0]-dx/2),0,-dy,float(lat[-1]+dy/2))
+    dest=ROOT/'base/bathymetry/miami-navd88.tif';dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    with rasterio.open(dest,'w',driver='GTiff',height=a.shape[0],width=a.shape[1],count=1,
+                       dtype='float32',crs='EPSG:4326',transform=tx,nodata=-99999,
+                       compress='deflate',predictor=3) as ds:ds.write(a,1)
+    p=ROOT/'reports/round3/bathymetry-source.json'
+    log=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}
+    log.update(url=requests.Request('GET',URL,params=PARAMS).prepare().url,
+        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=raw.stat().st_size,
+        subset_shape=list(a.shape),coordinate_array_bounds=[float(lon[0]),float(lat[0]),float(lon[-1]),float(lat[-1])],
+        corrected_georeference='Pixel centres from lon/lat arrays, WGS84 per NOAA documentation. Ignore stale full-grid actual_range and spherical grid_mapping.',
+        retained_geotiff_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
+    d=depth_at(1024);w=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'references/z0/surface_water.png'))>0
+    log['water_depth_percentiles_m_below_navd88']=np.percentile(d[w],[0,5,25,50,75,95,100]).tolist()
+    log['zero_or_above_datum_fraction_on_tiger_water']=float(np.mean(d[w]==0))
+    p.write_text(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+    prior=ROOT/'raw/round3/prior'
+    for z in range(4):
+        kept=ROOT/f'paintings/z{z}/retained-paint.png'
+        if not kept.exists():kept.write_bytes((prior/f'z{z}-final-master.png').read_bytes())
+    im=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'paintings/z0/retained-paint.png'))
+    im[w]=np.uint8(pigment(1024)[w]);Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/'reports/round3/depth-guide.png')
+    print(json.dumps(log,indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
